stance_rationale: PD20-B fixes the 20-stock production cap on paper, but the Forge package is not decision-grade: the mandated mailbox weights.csv is absent, the fallback weights.csv is a stale 155-date 5-sleeve high_20pct schedule, the code uses same-day liquidity data on 92/184 signal dates, and composite DSR/5-spec evidence is explicitly pending. Pure-function hashes and charts pass, but RF-F2/RF-F4/RF-F5/RF-F6 plus PIT-C10/C13/C14 gaps block approval.

critical_concerns.description: The mandated qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is absent. The available stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/weights.csv has 155 dates ending 2023-11-01 and method_selected=5sleeve_pareto_high_20pct_primary_smoothed_phi_0_5, not the claimed PD20-B 184-date 4-sleeve z-score composite schedule. run_all_pd20b.R also hardcodes sleeve weights instead of consuming a verified schedule.

The code claims ADV_20d uses PIT t-1, but build_pd20b_zscore_composite_returns.R selects rd[Date <= d_now] and uses a right-aligned ADV that includes the current date. 92 of 184 sig_dates are actual trading days, so same-day volume/close can enter the liquidity filter before the entry trade.

Composite-level DSR and 5-spec Harvey regressions are not present; the package states PENDING_JUDGE_RESPAWN for DSR M=19 and CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6. The only target-level significance test is DM t_NW=2.764, which fails the Harvey-Liu-Zhu t>3 bar.

Baseline fairness is incomplete. PD20-B primary returns embed a 90bps annual cost drag, while S4 baseline and PD18 comparison are not shown with the same cost model and the same DSR penalty. Same-period alone is insufficient under the Forge prompt.

Turnover is not reconciled to the hard hurdle. The package reports mean one-way turnover 0.519 per month, which annualizes to about 623% one-way and about 1246% round-trip before any portfolio-weight interpretation; the hard constraint is <600% annual.
PIT-C13/C14 are inherited as unresolved alpha-layer remediation. A Forge package cannot claim PIT-clean admission while Z_Score_Aligned-only recalculation and Usable_Date validation remain pending.

The 0.818/0.182 composite weight is derived from the previously selected PD18 sleeve allocation, not from an ex ante alpha-signal weighting rule. With z_NEW mean only +0.42 in selected names and cor(z_1715,z_NEW)=-0.347, the package has not shown that NEW alpha survives the 20-name consolidation robustly.

No Silent Override is not complete for this PD20-B draft: the package says challenge_note Part G PD20-B append is pending, while multiple core limitations are deferred to Judge re-spawn. That is disclosure, not resolution.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function md5s match the package claims: alpha e0e1a525c84f33f228f00c061ac5d64d, risk 25a440e08232fcfb953ca912bffaa13a, optimization a810ddbaf40f5a90b054c521e915e106.
alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series artifact with 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, and 770 tickers.
covariance.parquet is symmetric PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0121714 and condition number 8.812, so the user-specified PSD/cond<=100 check passes for that artifact.
PD20-B holdings.csv has 3,680 rows, exactly 184 sig_dates x 20 stocks, with 2.75% portfolio weight per KR equity name.
Charts exist and post-lockbox data are non-missing: equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present; period_returns has 28 rows after 2023-12-22.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a missing canonical weights.csv can be replaced by hardcoded run_all_pd20b.R weights plus holdings.csv without violating RF-F2.
Whether forge-stage lockbox 폐기 is a formally approved exception to the base Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined reporting promise for this decision.
Whether the same-day ADV_20d issue changes the selected top20 enough to invalidate reported SR/MDD/CVaR.
Whether PD20-B can supersede PD18 when it has lower DM evidence, worse MDD, and pending DSR/5-spec validation.
Whether the 0.818/0.182 composite weight is robust outside the inherited PD18 allocation ratio.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that the PD18 sleeve allocation ratio can be mechanically reused as a 0.818/0.182 alpha-signal mixing rule, producing a robust 20-stock replacement for the 40-stock PD18 structure without reintroducing selection bias or diluting NEW alpha.
rebuttal_required: Publish the mandated PD20-B weights.csv at qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv, or formally amend the artifact contract, and make run_all_pd20b.R consume it.
Replace the liquidity filter with strict t-1 data, rerun holdings/returns, and report top20 overlap plus metric deltas.
Produce composite-level DSR M=19 and CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, FF6 regressions for both PD20-B and same-period baseline.
Recompute S4 and PD18 comparisons with identical period, cost model, turnover convention, and DSR penalty.
Report annual turnover against the <600% hard hurdle using both one-way and round-trip definitions.
Provide sensitivity results for composite weights such as 0.5/0.5, 0.7/0.3, 0.9/0.1, and z-weighted holdings.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge self-disclosure is useful, but AX-008 cannot count this draft as a PASS while RF-F2, RF-F4, RF-F5, RF-F6, PIT-C10, PIT-C13, and PIT-C14 remain unresolved.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Yes.

walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? No; alpha_scores and holdings have 184 dates, but the mandated weights.csv is missing and the fallback weights.csv is a stale 155-date 5-sleeve schedule.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Yes; however frozen extension is not applied and lockbox-period evidence is not formally segregated.
